description: This file defines the ShareAPI interface for interacting with share-related endpoints in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes method signatures for retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting shares, as well as sending emails related to shares.

classes.name: ShareAPI
classes.description: Interface defining API endpoints for sharing functionalities in the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: getSharees
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sharees based on search criteria, with default parameters for format, itemType, and lookup.

methods.name: getShares
methods.description: Fetches shares associated with a specific remote ID, including tags.

methods.name: getSharesForSpecificNote
methods.description: Retrieves shares related to a specific note identified by its path, including reshares and subfiles.

methods.name: removeShare
methods.description: Deletes a share identified by its share ID.

methods.name: addShare
methods.description: Creates a new share using the provided request data.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends an email related to a share, optionally including a password.

methods.name: updateShare
methods.description: Updates an existing share with new data.

methods.name: updateSharePermission
methods.description: Updates the permissions of an existing share.

methods.name: getShareFromNote
methods.description: Retrieves shares associated with a specific note, filtered to those shared with the current user.
